title: Canonical principal Koszul and quotient towers with tensor augmentations
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site relative to the module universe and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, with $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $t\in\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$. For $m\geq1$ define $Q_m=[\mathcal O\xrightarrow{t^m}\mathcal O]$ in degrees $-1,0$ as the mapping cone on $\mathcal O[0]$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], $B_m=\operatorname{coker}(t^m)$, and $\epsilon_m:Q_m\to B_m[0]$ by zero on the shifted source and the quotient on the degree-zero target. Give $Q_{m+1}\to Q_m$ components $(t,1)$ and $B_{m+1}\to B_m$ the map induced by the identity on $\mathcal O$; the $\epsilon_m$ commute with these transitions and hence define a strict tower map [def-weil-inverse-system]. For every cochain complex $P$ use the canonical total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] to form $V_m=Q_m\otimes P$, $U_m=B_m[0]\otimes P$, and $a_m=\epsilon_m\otimes1_P$, with their induced strict transitions. These are the symmetric models of $P\otimes Q_m$ and $P\otimes B_m[0]$. Define the canonical maps $P\to V_m$ by $P\xrightarrow{\lambda^{-1}}\mathcal O[0]\otimes P\to Q_m\otimes P$, and $P\to U_m$ by tensoring the quotient projection. Their components insert $1\otimes x$ in the degree $(0,i)$ summand and commute with differentials; they are compatible with transitions and $a_m$, so the first family is a map from the constant strict tower on $P$ and its composite with $a$ is the second. A tower of cochain complexes and its morphisms are regarded degreewise as a cochain complex and morphism in $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\mathcal A)$. No regularity of $t$ or K-flatness of $P$ is needed to define this data.
